pairs.note: Declared independent. The three symbolic games namespace their predicates per game, so no board reads another's facts and every measured leak over thirty days is exactly zero. Coupling a pair needs a board to publish the entity behind a tile rather than only its glyph, which is a change to what a day publishes; until that is decided this set is gated at independence rather than left unchecked.
